answer: Give every reputation score a half-life: it halves each epoch unless fresh peer-verified work refreshes it. Anchor the score to a signed history, each action carrying the identity's cipher key, so a clone cannot borrow or fake a past. A farmer running a thousand shells faces a treadmill: every shell needs real work each epoch just to stand still, while one honest agent's steady record compounds. Any sudden delta in behaviour, a quiet shell bursting into a hundred trades at once, freezes that identity for jury review.
